_note: 學習路徑內容建置第14批 #5／6：no matter how／what／where 讓步副詞子句（eng.t_adv.advcl.no-matter，學測級／高階）。no matter＋how／what／where／when／who 引導讓步副詞子句，意思是『不管…、無論…』，等於 however／whatever／wherever。鐵律：no matter how＋形容詞／副詞＋主詞＋動詞；no matter how＝however、no matter what＝whatever、no matter where＝wherever；講未來的子句用現在簡單式不用 will。誘答以『對應詞配錯（how↔however）／語序錯／未來誤用 will』鎖唯一正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix nmt_）。

units.can_do: 我能用 no matter＋how／what／where／when／who 引導讓步副詞子句表『不管、無論』，知道 no matter how＝however、no matter what＝whatever、no matter where＝wherever，也知道 no matter how 後接形容詞／副詞＋主詞＋動詞、講未來的子句用現在簡單式。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'No matter + how/what/where/when/who' begins a concession clause meaning 'it does not matter; regardless': 'No matter what happens, we will be fine.'
claims.verification_ref: no matter＋how/what/where/when/who 引導讓步子句、意為『不管、無論』；No matter what happens, we will be fine；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'No matter how/what/where' means the same as 'however/whatever/wherever': 'No matter how hard it is' = 'However hard it is.'
claims.verification_ref: no matter how＝however、no matter what＝whatever、no matter where＝wherever；No matter how hard it is＝However hard it is；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: When 'how' asks about degree, 'no matter how' is followed by an adjective or adverb, then subject + verb: 'No matter how tired she is, she keeps going.'
claims.verification_ref: how 問程度時 no matter how＋形容詞／副詞＋主詞＋動詞（No matter how tired she is）；manner 義（No matter how you do it）則直接接主詞＋動詞；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: In a 'no matter' clause about the future, we use the present simple, not 'will': 'No matter what he says, I won't change my mind.' (not 'no matter what he will say').
claims.verification_ref: 講未來的 no matter 子句用現在簡單式、不用 will；No matter what he says, I won't change my mind；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: 'No matter + how/what/where/when/who' begins a clause meaning 'it does not matter' or 'whatever happens': No matter what happens, I will support you.
teach.zh_hint: no matter＋how／what／where／when／who 引導一個讓步副詞子句，意思是『不管…、無論…（都沒差）』：No matter what happens, I will support you.（不管發生什麼事，我都會支持你。）

teach.body: No matter how hard I try, I can't fix it.
teach.zh_hint: 不管我多努力，都修不好。no matter how＋形容詞／副詞。

teach.body: You can replace these with one word: 'no matter how' = 'however', 'no matter what' = 'whatever', 'no matter where' = 'wherever'. The meaning is exactly the same.
teach.zh_hint: 這些說法可以換成一個字：no matter how＝however、no matter what＝whatever、no matter where＝wherever。意思完全一樣。

teach.body: No matter what happens, I will support you.
teach.zh_hint: 不管發生什麼，我都會支持你。no matter what＝whatever。

teach.body: Key points: when 'how' asks about degree, 'no matter how' takes an adjective or adverb, then a subject and a verb (No matter how tired she is...). Also, in a clause about the future, use the present simple, not 'will': No matter what he says (not 'he will say').
teach.zh_hint: 重點：當 how 問『程度』時，no matter how 後面接『形容詞或副詞』，再接主詞＋動詞（No matter how tired she is…）。另外講未來的子句裡用現在簡單式、不用 will：No matter what he says（不是 he will say）。

teach.body: No matter where you go, I will find you.
teach.zh_hint: 不管你去哪裡，我都會找到你。no matter where＝wherever。

teach.body: No matter who asks, I won't tell the secret.
teach.zh_hint: 不管誰問，我都不會說出這個秘密。no matter who＝whoever，指『人』。

teach.body: No matter when he arrives, we will welcome him.
teach.zh_hint: 不管他何時到，我們都會歡迎他。no matter when＝whenever，指『時間』；子句講未來用現在式 arrives。

practice.stem: 'No matter how hard it is' 意思等於哪一個？

distractor_rationales.Whatever hard it is: no matter what 才等於 whatever；no matter how 等於 however。
distractor_rationales.Wherever hard it is: no matter where 才等於 wherever；how 要對 however。
distractor_rationales.Whenever hard it is: no matter when 才等於 whenever；how 要對 however。

practice.feedback: no matter how＝however：However hard it is。

practice.stem: 填入正確說法：'____ you choose, I'll be happy.'（不管你選什麼）

distractor_rationales.No matter how: how 問『多…／怎樣』；這裡是『選什麼』，要用 what。
distractor_rationales.No matter where: where 問地點；這裡是『選什麼』，要用 what。
distractor_rationales.No matter who: who 問人；這裡是『選什麼東西』，要用 what。

practice.feedback: 『選什麼』用 no matter what：No matter what you choose。

practice.stem: 選正確的語序：No matter how ____, he keeps running.（不管外面多冷）

distractor_rationales.it is cold: no matter how 後面先接形容詞 cold，再接主詞＋動詞：cold it is。
distractor_rationales.is it cold: 這不是問句；no matter how 子句語序是 how＋形容詞＋主詞＋動詞。
distractor_rationales.it cold is: 語序錯；要 how cold（形容詞）＋it is（主詞＋動詞）。

practice.feedback: no matter how＋形容詞＋主詞＋動詞：No matter how cold it is。

practice.stem: 選正確動詞：No matter when he ____ back, we will wait.（不管他何時回來）

distractor_rationales.will come: 講未來的 no matter 子句用現在簡單式、不用 will；要用 comes。
distractor_rationales.came: came 是過去式；這裡講未來（we will wait），用現在式 comes。
distractor_rationales.would come: would 不合這裡的語境；用現在簡單式 comes。

practice.feedback: 講未來用現在簡單式：No matter when he comes back。

practice.stem: 填入正確說法：'____ you travel, bring your passport.'（不管你去哪裡旅行）

distractor_rationales.No matter what: what 問『什麼東西』；這裡是『去哪裡旅行』，要用 where。
distractor_rationales.No matter who: who 問人；這裡是地點，要用 where。
distractor_rationales.No matter how: how 問『多…／怎樣』；這裡是地點，要用 where。

practice.feedback: 『去哪裡旅行』用 no matter where：No matter where you travel。

practice.stem: 填入正確說法：'____ calls, tell them I'm busy.'（不管誰打電話來）

distractor_rationales.No matter what: what 問『什麼東西』；這裡是『誰打來』，指人，要用 who。
distractor_rationales.No matter where: where 問地點；這裡是『誰』，要用 who。
distractor_rationales.No matter how: how 問『多…／怎樣』；這裡是『誰』，要用 who。

practice.feedback: 『誰』用 no matter who：No matter who calls。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: No matter when you call, I will answer.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：No matter when you call 有沒有寫對、逗號與句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。no matter 子句微停、主句句尾下收。

lines.intonation: No matter what happens 微停、stay calm 句尾下收

lines.intonation: No matter how long it takes 微停、I will wait 句尾下收
